cross_component_finding: This page is a REST-reference-format twin of round 21's analytics/rest-analytics.md + query-params.md + query-responses.md: identical endpoints (/analytics/service, /query/service), identical parameter tables (Common Parameters, Analytics Parameters), and identical response schema (Common Responses, Analytics Responses, Plans, Analytics Metrics), generated from the cb-swagger OpenAPI source (per the page's editUrl frontmatter) rather than written as continuous prose. This is structurally the same situation the round brief flagged specifically for the n1ql-rest-* batch (an older prose-style REST reference and a newer, reorganized one covering the same surface) even though the round's general framing asserted 'no other version or twin exists' for the analytics-rest-* pages - that assertion does not hold for this page, which is a genuine second-format twin of already-extracted content, not first contact. New factual content limited to: the Security section's full six-role RBAC list (Full Admin, Cluster Admin, Analytics Manager, Analytics Reader, Analytics Select, Analytics Admin) documented as a formal requirement, resolving round 21's rest-analytics.json notable_absence that Full Administrator only ever appeared as a worked-example credential rather than a documented hard requirement - this page shows the hard requirement does exist and is a six-way disjunction, not just Full Administrator.
cross_product_finding: No Capella-specific content appears on this page; it documents only the on-premises Server REST surface at its cb-swagger-generated canonical location.
